headline.en: UNI trades 14% below treasury's burn cost as net inflation persists despite 7-day 27% collapse
headline.zh: UNI 跌破 DAO 回购成本 14%，7 日暴跌 27% 后净通胀问题依然存在

keyChanges.en: Price crashed 26.83% over 7 days to $5.13, now 14% below the $5.96 treasury burn anchor
keyChanges.zh: 价格 7 日暴跌 26.83% 至 $5.13，较 DAO 国库回购成本 $5.96 低 14%

keyChanges.en: Net inflation at +1.91%/year: 20M UNI annual emission dwarfs 3.04M UNI buyback capacity at current price
keyChanges.zh: 净通胀率 +1.91%/年：年度增发 2000 万 UNI 远超当前价格下 304 万 UNI 回购能力

keyChanges.en: TVL dropped 11.70% in 7 days to $3.07B while protocol revenue remains strong at $91.62M annualized
keyChanges.zh: TVL 7 日下跌 11.70% 至 30.7 亿美元，但协议年化收入维持强劲的 9162 万美元

contrarianObservation.en: The DAO burned 100M UNI at $5.96 implied cost six months ago—current price represents a 14% discount to the treasury's own fair value mark. With neutral funding, modest open interest, and no leverage cascade, this resembles organic capitulation where smart accumulation historically occurs, not a structurally broken asset.
contrarianObservation.zh: DAO 半年前以 $5.96 隐含成本回购销毁 1 亿 UNI——当前价格相当于较 DAO 自身估值打 86 折。资金费率中性、持仓量温和、无杠杆踩踏，这更像是有机抛售衰竭期（历史上聪明资金介入区域），而非结构性崩坏

watchNext.zh: 治理论坛是否出现真实收益 RFC 提案——唯一能让 UNI 从反身性估值转向现金流估值的催化剂

watchNext.en: Breakeven price calculation: UNI needs ~$6.80 for buyback volume to match 20M annual emission and achieve net-zero inflation
watchNext.zh: 盈亏平衡价格追踪：UNI 需达到约 $6.80 才能让回购量匹配 2000 万年度增发实现净零通胀

watchNext.en: TVL trend vs broader DeFi—whether 11.7% drop is Uniswap-specific exodus or alt-wide weakness from 59% BTC dominance
watchNext.zh: TVL 走势对比 DeFi 大盘——11.7% 跌幅是 Uniswap 特有资金外流还是 BTC 主导率 59% 导致的山寨币整体疲软

fullReasoning.en: UNI is trapped in valuation purgatory. The 7-day 26.83% decline pushed price to $5.13, now 14% below the $5.96 treasury burn anchor—the DAO's own implied fair value from its 100M token buyback. Protocol fundamentals remain solid with $91.62M annualized revenue, but token economics are broken: at current price, buybacks can only retire 3.04M UNI against 20M annual emissions, leaving +1.91% net inflation. Markets aren't pricing improving fundamentals; they're pricing a diluting asset without a catalyst. TVL's 11.7% weekly drop signals user exodus, though broader alt weakness from 59.35% BTC dominance likely amplifies Uniswap-specific concerns. Derivatives paint a less dire picture: $30.53M open interest is modest, neutral funding, and 1.68 long/short ratio suggest organic exhaustion rather than leveraged panic. The critical variable remains unchanged: no real-yield RFC in governance. Without action to redirect buybacks to stakers, UNI stays reflexive—price must rise for burns to matter, but there's no catalyst. The protocol is healthy; the token is not. Until governance fixes net inflation or price climbs above $6.80 where burn exceeds emission, UNI remains in a value trap. The $5.13 level may attract value buyers betting on reversion to treasury's cost basis, but mean reversion requires a reason this market hasn't provided.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 陷入估值炼狱。7 日暴跌 26.83% 至 $5.13，较 DAO 通过 1 亿代币回购确立的 $5.96 隐含公允价值低 14%。协议基本面依然稳健，年化收入 9162 万美元，但代币经济学已失灵：当前价格下回购仅能销毁 304 万 UNI，远不及 2000 万年度增发，净通胀率 +1.91%。市场定价的不是改善的基本面，而是一个缺乏催化剂的稀释性资产。TVL 单周下跌 11.7% 显示用户流失，尽管 BTC 主导率 59.35% 导致的山寨币整体疲软可能放大了 Uniswap 自身问题。衍生品数据不那么悲观：3053 万美元持仓量温和，资金费率中性，多空比 1.68 表明这是有机抛售衰竭而非杠杆踩踏。核心变量未变：治理层面仍无真实收益 RFC。在 DAO 投票将回购资金从销毁转向质押分红之前，UNI 保持反身性——价格必须上涨才能让销毁机制有意义，但市场没有推动价格的催化剂。协议健康，代币不健康。除非治理修复净通胀问题，或价格涨至 $6.80 以上（回购超过增发的临界点），否则 UNI 仍困在价值陷阱。$5.13 可能吸引押注均值回归至 DAO 成本线的价值投资者，但均值回归需要理由，而市场尚未给出。
